verdict.rationale: Jan documents a built-in OpenAI-compatible REST API at localhost:1337. The API reference covers GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions (streaming, tool calling) and an Anthropic-compatible POST /v1/messages, each with curl examples, so programmatic clients can drive Jan's inference. The documented surface is limited to inference endpoints, though, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: API control of broader app features (assistants, projects, model downloads, MCP), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, a versioning/stability policy, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Jan's local API server exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API at http://127.0.0.1:1337. Use it as a drop-in replacement for cloud APIs in any application that supports OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
Jan provides a built-in, OpenAI-compatible API server that runs entirely on your computer, powered by `llama.cpp`.
OpenAI-Compatible API: Local server at `localhost:1337` for other applications
